_comment: PreToolUse hook: blocks any Bash tool call that contains 'git push'. The hook exits 1, which causes Claude to treat the tool call as blocked and report the reason to the user.

PreToolUse._comment: Matcher 'Bash' fires on every shell command Claude attempts to run.

hooks._comment: CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT is set by Claude Code to the JSON-encoded tool input before the hook runs. For the Bash tool this includes the 'command' field. The grep checks for 'git push' anywhere in that input. If found: print a message and exit 1 (blocked). If not found: exit 0 (allowed).
hooks.command: echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | grep -q 'git push' && echo 'BLOCKED: git push commands are not permitted from Claude sessions. Use your terminal to push after reviewing changes.' >&2 && exit 1 || exit 0
